Platform

Operational features

Acutis enables residential and mental health service providers to manage daily operations, record documentation, and demonstrate compliance.

Timeline ViewFormsFacility MappingAudit & Compliance

resident

Resident Management

resident

Resident Management

A structured record for every resident — demographics, admission details, care classification, assigned unit, and current status — maintained as a single inspectable object.

  • Admission and discharge lifecycle tracking
  • Care classification and dependency scoring
  • Assigned keyworker and care team records
  • Legal status and consent documentation
  • Per-resident flagging and alert configuration
HIQA StandardsMental Health CommissionTusla Inspection

incident

Incident Reporting

incident

Incident Reporting

Structured incident capture from the moment of occurrence through investigation, corrective action, and formal closure — with a complete, timestamped audit trail.

  • Typed incident categories with mandatory fields per type
  • Immediate notification workflows to designated persons
  • Investigation assignment and evidence attachment
  • Root cause analysis structured input
  • Regulatory reporting flag for notifiable incidents
HIQA StandardsMental Health CommissionHSE RequirementsNI RQIA

audit

Audit & Compliance

audit

Audit Management

Schedule, conduct, and close audits against defined standards. Every finding, corrective action, and sign-off recorded and retained against the inspectable record.

  • Recurring audit schedule with regulatory cycle alignment
  • Checklist-based evidence capture per standard
  • Finding classification by severity
  • Corrective action assignment with due dates
  • Formal closure with sign-off record
HIQA StandardsNI RQIAISO 27001

programme

Programme Delivery

programme

Care Programmes

Define and manage structured care programmes at service or resident level. Goals, reviews, and outcomes tracked against the programme timeline.

  • Programme templates per care type and sector
  • Goal setting with measurable outcome criteria
  • Scheduled review dates with reminder workflows
  • Multi-disciplinary team input per review
HIQA StandardsMental Health CommissionHSE Requirements

form

Forms & Documentation

form

Form Management

A library of structured clinical and administrative forms — admission, assessment, consent, incident, discharge — completed in system and retained against the relevant record.

  • Pre-built form library for regulated care contexts
  • Digital signature capture
  • Mandatory field enforcement before submission
  • Version history and amendment tracking
HIQA StandardsGDPR / Data ProtectionTusla Inspection

Facility Mapping

facility

Facility Mapping

Model your organisation's physical structure — from organisation to facility to building to unit to room. Every resident and event located within the hierarchy.

  • Multi-site organisation hierarchy
  • Unit capacity and occupancy tracking
  • Resident-to-room assignment history
  • Physical environment compliance attributes

Compliance

Regulatory frameworks

The platform is designed to support demonstration of compliance with the following regulatory standards.

GDPR/ Data Protection Commission

All data is stored within the European Union.

Reviewed: January 2026

GDPR/ Data Protection Commission

Access to resident records is role-based and fully audited.

Reviewed: January 2026

GDPR/ Data Protection Commission

A Data Processing Agreement is provided to all client organisations.

Reviewed: January 2026

HIQA Standards/ HIQA

Platform record structures are designed against HIQA inspection requirements.

Reviewed: January 2026

Mental Health Commission/ Mental Health Commission

Incident and consent workflows reflect Mental Health Commission Rules for Approved Centres.

Reviewed: January 2026

NI RQIA/ RQIA

Audit and care record structures support RQIA inspection requirements in Northern Ireland.

Reviewed: January 2026
